title: Reading Practice Test 07 – Manufacturing & Quality
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: bản ghi nhớ, thư khiếu nại, bài báo có chèn câu, báo giá và e-mail). Chủ đề: sản xuất, an toàn, thu hồi sản phẩm, nhà cung cấp.

questions.content: The factory has ------- its production capacity by adding a second assembly line.
questions.explanation: Hiện tại hoàn thành 'has + V3' → 'increased'.

questions.content: All machines must be inspected ------- before the start of each shift.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ bị động 'be inspected' → 'carefully'.

questions.content: Only a ------- of the samples failed the quality test.
questions.explanation: 'a few of + danh từ đếm được số nhiều (samples)'. 'a little' dùng cho danh từ không đếm được; 'a many/a much' sai.

questions.content: Workers are required to wear protective gloves ------- handling chemicals.
questions.explanation: 'when + V-ing' (mệnh đề trạng ngữ rút gọn) = khi xử lý hoá chất. 'during' chỉ đi với danh từ.

questions.content: The new robotic arm can assemble components ------- than any human worker.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'assemble' + có 'than' → so sánh hơn của trạng từ 'more quickly'.

questions.content: Production was suspended for two days ------- a shortage of steel.
questions.explanation: Chỉ nguyên nhân + cụm danh từ 'a shortage of steel' → 'because of'.

questions.content: The plant manager ------- the new safety procedures at yesterday's meeting.
questions.explanation: Dấu hiệu 'yesterday' → quá khứ đơn 'explained'.

questions.content: Our engineers are working to make the manufacturing process more -------.
questions.explanation: make + O + tính từ; 'more efficient' = hiệu quả hơn.

questions.content: The factory ------- more than 5,000 bicycles each month.
questions.explanation: Nhà máy 'sản xuất' xe đạp → 'manufactures'. 'employs' dùng cho người; 'consists' cần 'of'.

questions.content: The warehouse is located ------- the factory, so materials can be moved quickly.
questions.explanation: 'next to' = ngay cạnh. 'between' cần hai đối tượng; 'among' cần một nhóm; 'beside of' sai ngữ pháp.

groups.passage:
PRODUCT RECALL NOTICE

HomePro Appliances is voluntarily recalling its Model KX200 electric kettle. The recall ---131--- about 12,000 kettles sold between January and April of this year.

Our testing has shown that the handle may become loose after repeated use. ---132---, there have been no reports of injuries. However, we are taking this step as a precaution.

Customers who own the affected model should stop using it ---133---. ---134---. The model number can be found on the bottom of the kettle.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience.

questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'The recall' số ít, diễn tả sự thật hiện tại → 'affects' (ảnh hưởng tới/áp dụng cho).
Sau tin xấu (tay cầm có thể lỏng), câu sau là tin tốt (chưa có ai bị thương) → 'Fortunately'.
Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'stop using' → trạng từ 'immediately'.

options.A: The kettle comes in three colors.
options.B: Our new models will be released next year.
options.C: Tea is best made with fresh water.
options.D: They may return it to any HomePro store for a full refund.

questions.explanation: Sau khi yêu cầu ngừng dùng, câu hợp lý hướng dẫn khách xử lý sản phẩm: trả lại để hoàn tiền.

groups.passage:
MEMO
To: Assembly Line Staff
From: Victor Nwosu, Plant Manager
Date: August 12

Beginning next Monday, all employees working on the assembly line must wear the new safety glasses provided by the company. The old glasses do not meet updated safety regulations. Please collect your new pair from the equipment room before your shift. Supervisors will check that everyone is wearing the correct glasses.

questions.content: What is the purpose of the memo?

options.A: To announce a new equipment requirement

questions.explanation: Từ thứ Hai, nhân viên dây chuyền phải đeo kính bảo hộ mới → yêu cầu mới về trang thiết bị.

questions.content: Where can employees get the new glasses?
questions.explanation: 'Please collect your new pair from the equipment room before your shift.' Giám sát viên chỉ kiểm tra.

groups.passage:
Dear Mr. Hoffman,

I am writing regarding our recent order of 2,000 metal hinges from Hoffman Industrial Supply, which arrived on March 3. When our staff inspected the shipment, they found that approximately 300 of the hinges were bent and could not be used.

This is the second time in three months that we have received damaged parts from your company. Because our production schedule depends on timely deliveries, these problems have caused serious delays.

I would appreciate it if you could send 300 replacement hinges by March 10. I would also like to discuss how your company packages its products, as the damage seems to have occurred during shipping.

Sincerely,
Ana Kovač
Purchasing Manager, Brightline Furniture

questions.content: Why did Ms. Kovač write the letter?
questions.explanation: Khoảng 300 bản lề bị cong, không dùng được → báo hàng bị hư hỏng.

questions.content: What is indicated about Brightline Furniture?

options.A: It has had a similar problem before.
options.D: It has changed its production schedule.

questions.explanation: 'This is the second time in three months that we have received damaged parts' → đã từng gặp vấn đề tương tự.

questions.content: What does Ms. Kovač suggest caused the damage?
questions.explanation: Cô muốn bàn về cách đóng gói vì 'the damage seems to have occurred during shipping'.

groups.passage:
Deltron Opens Highly Automated Plant
By Kevin Osei

GREENVILLE – Electronics maker Deltron Corp. officially opened its new manufacturing plant in Greenville on Monday. The facility, which cost $150 million to build, uses robots to perform about 70 percent of the assembly work. [1]

Deltron says the automation will allow the plant to produce 40,000 circuit boards per day, twice as many as its older facility in Ohio. [2] Despite the heavy use of robots, the plant has created 450 jobs, most of them in machine maintenance, programming, and quality control.

"Automation does not eliminate the need for skilled workers," said plant director Maria Santos. [3] "It changes the type of skills we need." Deltron has partnered with Greenville Technical College to offer training programs for local residents. [4]

questions.content: What is the article mainly about?

options.A: The closing of a plant in Ohio
options.C: The opening of a manufacturing facility

questions.explanation: Deltron khai trương nhà máy tự động hoá cao ở Greenville.

questions.content: What is stated about the Greenville plant?

options.A: It can produce twice as much as the Ohio plant.
options.B: It cost less than expected to build.
options.D: It is run entirely by robots.

questions.explanation: '…produce 40,000 circuit boards per day, twice as many as its older facility in Ohio.' (D) sai – robot làm khoảng 70%.

questions.content: The word "eliminate" in paragraph 3, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'does not eliminate the need' = không loại bỏ nhu cầu → eliminate = remove.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Participants who complete the program will be guaranteed an interview at the plant."
questions.explanation: 'the program' chỉ chương trình đào tạo với trường Greenville Technical College vừa nhắc → vị trí [4].

groups.passage:
Precision Packaging Co. – Price Quote
Prepared for: Lumen Cosmetics
Date: May 2

Glass bottles, 50 ml – 10,000 units × $0.40 = $4,000
Plastic caps – 10,000 units × $0.08 = $800
Printed labels – 10,000 units × $0.05 = $500
Shipping – $350
Total: $5,650

Orders of more than $5,000 (before shipping) qualify for free shipping if payment is made within 10 days of the invoice date. This quote is valid for 30 days. Standard production time is three weeks.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: sales@precisionpackaging.com
From: Irene Fuchs, Lumen Cosmetics
Date: May 6
Subject: Quote for bottles

Hello,

Thank you for the quote you sent on May 2. We would like to proceed with the order, with one change: we have decided to keep using our current label supplier, so please remove the printed labels from the order.

We need the bottles and caps by June 1 for the launch of our new perfume line, so the standard production time works for us. We will pay the invoice immediately upon receipt.

Please confirm the revised total.

Best regards,
Irene Fuchs

questions.content: What is Lumen Cosmetics preparing to do?

options.B: Introduce a new line of products

questions.explanation: '…for the launch of our new perfume line' → ra mắt dòng sản phẩm mới.

questions.content: What item will be removed from the order?
questions.explanation: 'Please remove the printed labels from the order.'

questions.content: What will the revised total most likely be?
questions.explanation: Bỏ nhãn: $4,000 + $800 = $4,800 (dưới $5,000 nên không được miễn phí vận chuyển) + $350 phí ship = $5,150.

questions.content: What is suggested about the revised order?

options.A: It will not qualify for free shipping.
options.B: It will take longer to produce.
options.C: It must be paid in advance.

questions.explanation: Dù trả tiền ngay, giá trị đơn mới ($4,800) không vượt $5,000 theo điều kiện trong báo giá → không được miễn phí vận chuyển.

questions.content: In the e-mail, the word "proceed" in paragraph 1, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'proceed with the order' = tiếp tục/tiến hành đơn hàng → continue.
